standard.summary: 是否将 LoRA 注入所有线性层（包括 MLP 的 fc1/fc2）。开启后注入面更广，表达力更强。
standard.effect: 默认 False = 只注入注意力层（Q/K/V/Out）；True = 同时注入 MLP 的全连接层，参数量大幅增加。
standard.whenToUse: 复杂概念/多角色训练时开启，以获得更强的表达力。简单风格 LoRA 可保持 False。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存紧张时，注入 MLP 线性层会显著增加参数量和显存。

standard_en.summary: Whether LoRA is injected into every linear layer, the MLP's fc1/fc2 included. Once on the injection surface is wider and expressiveness greater.
standard_en.effect: The default False injects into the attention layers only (Q/K/V/Out); True also injects the MLP's fully connected layers, which raises the parameter count sharply.
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn it on for complex concepts or multi-character training, where the extra expressiveness helps. A simple style LoRA can leave it False.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When VRAM is tight -- injecting the MLP linears adds parameters and memory noticeably.

advanced.principle: 遍历模型所有 nn.Linear 层（而非只有 attention projection），为每个线性层添加 LoRA 旁路。MLP 层的激活函数位于线性层之间，不受 LoRA 影响。
advanced.tradeoffs: 注入 MLP 可以捕获特征空间的变化，不只是注意力路径，但参数量约增加 2~3 倍。

advanced_en.principle: Traverses all nn.Linear layers in the model (not just attention projections), adding a LoRA bypass to each. MLP layers' activations sit between linear layers and are untouched by LoRA.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Injecting MLP captures feature-space changes beyond just attention paths, but parameter count grows roughly 2~3×.
